title: Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. translated_title: 测试时潜在空间计算以提升多模态大语言模型的视觉感知能力
translated_abstract: 近期关于大语言模型（LLM）的研究表明，推理能力不仅可以通过更长的token级推理链在测试时得到增强，还可以通过在潜在空间中进行额外计算来提升。这为多模态大语言模型（MLLM）提出了一个自然的问题：潜在空间中的额外计算能否在测试时改善视觉感知？在本研究中，我们首先验证了MLLM包含稳定的可复用层，这些层可以在推理时被重新前向传播而不干扰正常的生成过程。基于这一观察，我们提出了潜在空间回看方法（Look Back in the Latent Space，Lobals），这是一种免训练的解码方法，它识别出对视觉token注意力最强的连续层窗口并对其进行重新前向传播，使模型能够在潜在空间中重新审视视觉证据。我们证明了这种潜在空间重访策略可以提升MLLM的性能。
tldr: 提出免训练解码方法Lobals，通过在测试时重新前向传播对视觉token注意力最强的层窗口，使多模态大语言模型能在潜在空间中重访视觉证据，从而提升视觉感知性能。
en_tdlr: Lobals is a training-free decoding method that re-forwards the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention at test time, enabling multimodal large language models to revisit visual evidence in latent space and improve visual perception.
